name: Kagerou no Shiva
source:
Earth Age: 20 years old.
Special Trait: Hair ornament
Element: Dark
Abilities: Can transform into other people for a short time

He's selfish and self-centered and easily becomes deeply jealous of others.
But really he's just lonely and starving for love, he just can't be honest though.
